verdict.rationale: Stark Bank offers scheduled transfers and approval flows, so versioning and rolling back automations is a fair question for this product. The evidence shows no way to version, review, or roll back user automations. Payment approval flows and the API's no-breaking-changes policy are adjacent features, not versioning or rollback of a user's own automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
